title.narrative: RS! Mozambique-Tea

description.narrative: To contribute to a responsible and inclusive global tea value chain that ensures that value is distributed fairly, smallholder tea farmers and workers benefit from decent working conditions and tea is produced with respect to the environment.The main objectives of the project are The target groups are producers tea association, regional and national association of tea trade assoication, national small scale tea growers, agricultural workers union, women's groups, civil society groups. Objectives 1. To create, strengthen and/or join in dialogue to enhance access to knowledge, information and credible evidence, where vulnerable groups are included and policy makers can make informed decisions. 2. To strengthen the ability of civil society to claim and defend their rights and influence decision making 3. To mobilise activate and engage citizens and CSOs to change norms and influence the policy agenda for the range of issues highlighted in the problem analysis

comment.narrative: TrustAfrica and Solidaridad initiated dialogue on decent work for women and men in the Malawi Tea Industry. This was done through a partnership engagement workshop convened by the Tea Association of Malawi where all the important stakeholders in the tea sector convened including the government agencies, smallholder farmers associations, NGOs, and the tea producers.
